subject: science
concept: Designing and conducting an investigation into a population or ecosystem dynamic
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Planning and Carrying Out Investigations) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student designs and runs a simple population or ecosystem simulation and records results across simulated time
exercise.abstract: Student states a conclusion about the population or ecosystem dynamic based on their investigation's data

assessment.mastery_threshold: conclusion is supported by the investigation's actual recorded data
misconception_flags: states a conclusion contradicted by their own recorded investigation data

interest_binding: investigation topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
